row.locator:
| 12 | **TILE** — `dstW = floor(slack/numStretch / srcW) * srcW` (whole tiles) | `0x5266`-`0x5292` |
| 8, 11, 18 | **STRETCH (grow)** — `share = sVar5/sVar6 + slack/numStretch` | `0x529e`-`0x52d6` |
| 13, 14 | **STRETCH** smaller share (`sVar5/sVar6`, no slack term) | `0x52da`-`0x52f8` |
| else | call `0x49d6(pc,flag)`: nonzero → leave width 0 (budget participant); else FIXED `dstW=srcW`; **except** pc∈{5,6} AND flag==0 → width 0 (collapse) | `0x52fc`-`0x532a` |

So **codes 5/6** (title bezel) are FIXED when the title fits (`flag`=`fp@(-290)`
title-fits, pushed at `0x5100`/`0x5120`) and **collapse to 0** when it doesn't —
they never grow. Budget = `slack = (srcBorder[end]−srcBorder[start-1]) − reqWidth`
(`0x518a`); the primary divisor counts only 8/11/12/18 (`0x4b3e`), while 8/11/13/14/18
share the division and whole-tile remainder. Each remainder share is truncated
against the number of recipients still to visit, so extra pixels accumulate at
the END of the walk (3/3/4 for a budget of 10 and three ordinary growers)
row.claim: Two-pass per-half allocation: primary 8/11/12/18, whole-tile truncation, remainder to 8/11/13/14/18 toward the end; 0x49d6 stretch verdicts leave width 0.
row.limits: Within one half of a given extent with a nonnegative budget. Title-anchor half extents, codes 5/6 (title-fits flag, 0x5312), widget flag values and below-minimum behaviour are not established.

evidence.locator:
kDEF doesn't give up when `GetResource('wnd#', d3)` returns NULL — it walks a
12-step degraded-id cascade, ANDing `d3` against a fixed mask sequence and
re-attempting until a handle resolves.
evidence.claim: GetResource(wnd#, id & mask) over twelve masks; the first non-null handle ends the cascade.
evidence.limits: Masks and landing order only. A miss reaches the no-recipe path; the runtime heuristic substitute there, base-chain ownership and Resource Manager search order are not established.

evidence.locator:
Walking gives cells **`[border[i-1], border[i])` tagged `part[i]`**
(END-based — the part code travels with the border that CLOSES the cell;
`0x5356`, confirmed in `compositor-spec.md`). Segment loop starts at index 1, so
`[0, border[0])` is the fixed leading **corner** (drawn 1:1)
evidence.claim: Segment i spans [border[i-1], border[i]) tagged part[i]; [0, border[0]) is a 1:1 corner.
evidence.limits: Cell association only; trailing-region drawing and side draw order are not established.

evidence.locator:
| 12 | **TILE** — `dstW = floor(slack/numStretch / srcW) * srcW` (whole tiles) | `0x5266`-`0x5292` |
| 8, 11, 18 | **STRETCH (grow)** — `share = sVar5/sVar6 + slack/numStretch` | `0x529e`-`0x52d6` |
| 13, 14 | **STRETCH** smaller share (`sVar5/sVar6`, no slack term) | `0x52da`-`0x52f8` |
| else | call `0x49d6(pc, fp@(24))` (the too-short byte): nonzero → leave width 0 (budget participant); else FIXED `dstW=srcW`; **except** pc∈{5,6} AND `fp@(26)`==0 → width 0 (collapse) | `0x52fc`-`0x532a` |

So **codes 5/6** (title bezel) are FIXED when the `fp@(26)` byte is nonzero
(on the title path the GetWTitle length byte `fp@(-290)`, pushed at
`0x5100`/`0x5120`; zeroed at `0x4e20` when too short and `0x4f5e` when ≤2px of
title room is left) and **collapse to 0** when it is zero —
they never grow. Budget = `slack = (srcBorder[end]−srcBorder[start-1]) − reqWidth`
(`0x518a`); the primary divisor counts only 8/11/12/18 (`0x4b3e`), while 8/11/13/14/18
share the division and whole-tile remainder. Each remainder share is truncated
against the number of recipients still to visit, so extra pixels accumulate at
the END of the walk (3/3/4 for a budget of 10 and three ordinary growers)
evidence.claim: Two-pass per-half allocation: primary 8/11/12/18, whole-tile truncation, remainder to 8/11/13/14/18 toward the end; 0x49d6 stretch verdicts leave width 0.
evidence.limits: Within one half of a given extent with a nonnegative budget. Title-anchor half extents, codes 5/6 (fp@(26) title length byte, 0x530c), widget flag values and the second too-short step (0x4e24..0x4e42) are not established. 0x49d6 receives fp@(24), the too-short byte (kdef.too-short-step).

See §5.1. **Always tiles; never scales.** |

evidence.locator:
3. `0x4dfe..0x4e0c`: if `destBorder[N] − destBorder[0] < fp@(-16)`, then
   `fp@(-3) = 1`, `fp@(-16) −= fp@(-30)`, title width `fp@(-2) = 0` and the
   title string's length byte `fp@(-290) = 0` (`0x4e0e..0x4e20`). `fp@(-290)`
   is the GetWTitle Str255 (`0x4a98` `pea fp@(-290)`, `$A919`; `StringWidth`
   `$A88C` → `fp@(-2)`); its length byte is what reaches `fp@(26)` on the title
   path. It is also zeroed at `0x4f5e` when ≤2px of title room is left.
4. `0x4e24..0x4e42`: if the side is still too short and `fp@(-6) > 0`, it
   clears `a4@(500)` (the collapse/shade widget, which `0x487e` reads) and
   subtracts `fp@(-6)`.
5. In `0x5178`, code 10 with flag 1 goes `0x4a0c` → 1 → `bnes 0x532e`, with
   `d6 = 0` from `0x5260`. That gives **width 0**. With flag 0 the code is FIXED
   (`0x531e..0x532a`).
evidence.claim: Code 10 takes its source width unless the side is too short: fp@(-3) (passed as 0x5178 fp@(24) and returned by 0x4a0c) is set only at 0x4e0e when the placed extent (template extent + content delta) is below the sum of fixed segment widths; then code 10 gets width 0 and the title length/width are zeroed.
evidence.limits: Static listing reading; no native capture. The fixed sum depends on widget flags (codes 2/3/4/15/16/17), bounded but not decoded. The second step (shade-widget clear, 0x4e24..0x4e42), the titled-half split after a title drop and title-text drawing are not established. Popup family titled sides (0x4c64) skip the step.

The runtime drawTile anchors 11/14 at the far end. Limits: opaque source pixels only; opaque CopyBits under grafProcs and the CopyMask order over earlier sides are not modelled; runtime cross-axis placement and side-bar window; sampled sizes; no native capture.
